howBytesWereMeasured: Pixels: pdftoppm -r 150 -gray writing binary P5 PGM directly, WITH annotation appearances drawn (no -hide-annotations), ink threshold 128 (a pixel with grey value < 128 is ink), read by a PGM reader written for this lane. Scope: all 3 pages of both me-seal-survivor-set fixtures, before against after, 6 page pairs, whole page, no masking; each raster deleted immediately after it was read. Glyph geometry: every flattened widget appearance and every AcroForm /AP /N appearance stream in all six ar-drug-court-set fixture states decoded with pikepdf 10.12.0, the drawn string read from Tj/TJ operators including hex strings, the font size read from the Tf operator, and the string width computed against the widget BBox. Text: pdftotext -layout, -raw and -bbox (poppler 24.02.0). Digests: sha256sum. Every digest reported here was produced by a tool in this lane, never transcribed from a report.
everyZeroHasAPositiveControl: Yes, both zeros this lane reports carry a control it ran itself. (1) Raster zero: pages 3 of both me-seal-survivor-set fixtures measured 0 added and 0 removed pixels before against after. Control: one white pixel of new-canonical page 3 was forced to black and the same differ reported added=1, removed=0, bbox (600,800)-(600,800). The differ can see a single pixel, so the zero is a real zero. (2) Clipping zero: all four current ar-drug-court-set fixtures measured 0 appearances exceeding their widget BBox width. Control: the same detector, unchanged, was run on the pre-repair boundary bytes recovered from 26838a27b^ (sha256 cc5470f4faf9a92eafdf529e386f015015517514988ca1c7415a961668028f98 and 5ee9b46cac392fd7f6af81179084cf92906ed38d05578656057566d9f0dedd0f, the exact digests VF05 pinned) and fired on 10 appearances, reproducing VF05's case-number figure exactly - 118.05pt of text in a 104.85pt box. A detector that fires on the positive control and reports zero on the current bytes is reporting a real zero.
toleranceAndWhatItCanConceal: The clipping measurement is reported at two tolerances and both read zero. TOL=0 asks whether the drawn string is wider than the widget BBox. TOL=-2 asks whether it is wider than BBox minus 2pt, which is the width actually visible: each appearance stream sets its clip path inset 1pt on each side (the streams read 'q 1 1 m 1 <h-1> l <w-1> <h-1> l <w-1> 1 l h W n'), and the text origin is at x=1. The stricter figure is the honest one and it is the one that governs. What neither figure can conceal: a string wider than its box, at any magnitude down to 0.01pt. What both would conceal: ink drawn OUTSIDE any widget appearance, vertical overflow, and a collision between two appearances that each individually fit - none of which this instrument measures. It is a per-appearance width test, not a page test, and it is not a substitute for a raster of the delivered page against its pinned source. This lane did not run that raster on ar-drug-court-set because it moved none of its bytes.
